initial:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one cohesive football game ability concept sheet, preview only, landscape 1536x1024.
Primary request: show three different floating 3D pickup props with their matching 2D illustrated ability button icons, plus a clear deployed-wall scale scene, for a cheerful coastal arcade football game. Make this look like a polished game art director presentation, attractive sculpted bevels, saturated materials, deliberate highlights, readable silhouettes. Warm ivory sheet with deep navy typography, subtle mint accents, generous spacing. Exact header: "FOOTBALL / ABILITY PROTOTYPE". Subheader: "Floating pickups + matching illustrated buttons".
Top 60 percent: three equal organized columns. In EACH column a large hero 3D object floating over a faint floor shadow, and beside it a smaller cream rounded-square dark-navy outlined UI button with a simplified full-colour illustration of the SAME object (not a flat monochrome glyph).
Column 1 heading "TEAM TURBO": a chunky mint-and-navy CAPTAIN'S ARMBAND, short open cylinder, three golden forward chevrons across its front, two sweeping teal speed ribbons around it. No shoes, no basketball, no wings. Button same armband and chevrons. Short exact caption "1.5x team speed / 5s".
Column 2 heading "PORTAL STEAL": a tilted floating navy and violet HEXAGONAL split mechanical gateway, luminous blue inner rim and near-black centre, small black-and-white FOOTBALL halfway through, three small orbiting cyan shards. Distinct from an ordinary round portal. Button same football emerging through the hex gateway. Short exact caption "Own half / Ball to feet".
Column 3 heading "WALL": a chunky small orange-and-navy fold-out ground PROJECTOR with two short rounded side posts and a small pale blue transparent segmented holographic wall rising between them; looks like a miniature deployable barrier, not a shield badge. Button same orange two-post projector with three blue panels. Short exact caption "Place ahead / Lasts 15s".
Bottom 40 percent: one wide beautiful isometric illustration on a small green football grass patch, heading "DEPLOYED WALL". A friendly simple stylized blue-uniform footballer 1.75m tall stands beside a physical orange/navy ground emitter and a LARGE translucent pale-cyan energy barrier exactly THREE times his total height. Show width about 6m, height 5.25m, thin solid orange edge uprights, three clear glasslike energy panels, grass/player visible through it, not a brick wall. A black-and-white ball strikes the centre low on the barrier and rebounds with one neat curved motion trail and cyan contact ripple. Small readable labels "3x player height" and "15 seconds". Bottom-right small scale inset shows the two eligible pickup locations at opposite touchline ends of the midfield line on a top-down football pitch; title "CENTRE-LINE EDGES". Only one of the two locations lights blue with a floating transparent holographic "5".
Constraints: clean professional layout, all three separate props unmistakable at small scale, no existing franchise or brand logos, no weapon, no spaceship, no hands receiving ball, no basketball, no random text. Concept illustration, not a screenshot of a running Unity game.
refinement: Change only the bottom two illustration panels of this football ability concept sheet. Preserve the header and top three prop and icon columns exactly. Bottom left: keep the deployed wall scene but make the same footballer distinctly one-third the height of the wall, both feet and wall base on the same ground plane. The wall is 5.25m high and player 1.75m, accurate three times total standing character height; keep 6m width, translucent blue panels, orange posts, football contact ripple and existing labels. Bottom right CENTRE-LINE EDGES: replace the inset with a clean true top-down football pitch diagram, long vertical rectangle, goal at top and bottom, centre circle at geometric centre, HORIZONTAL halfway line stretching from LEFT TOUCHLINE to RIGHT TOUCHLINE. Show exactly two candidate circles where this halfway line meets the two side touchlines, slightly inset into grass. Only LEFT circle active glowing blue with a translucent upright holographic 5 above it, no prop at that location yet. RIGHT circle is a plain small inactive dotted navy circle with no prop and no number. Remove all other props from this inset. Add small caption 'One spawn at a time'. Match the beautiful polished graphic presentation, ivory background and navy type. Do not change any other artwork or text.
